# Intel Core Ultra 5 336H

![Intel Ultra 5 336H](fileadmin/_processed_/f/2/csm_Intel-Panther-Lake-16-core-and-4-Xe3-core-SKU_cdc96cfd75.jpg)

The Intel Core Ultra 5 336H is a mid-range 12-core SoC from the Panther Lake family for laptops. The chip also offers the smaller 4-core iGPU. Furthermore the chip offers support for vPro management features (vPro eligibility).

The 336H integrates a compute tile that is manufactured by Intel in the new 18A process. This includes 4 large Cougar Cove P-Cores with up to 1.9 - 4.6 GHz, 4 of the 8 Darkmont E-Cores with 1.5 - 3.6 GHz and another 4 small Darkmont LP (Low Power) E-Cores with 1.5 - 3.2 GHz. Furthermore, the new NPU 5 with 50 TOPS INT 8 and an IPU 7.5 image processor are installed. The integrated memory controller supports up to 96 GB LPDDR5-9600 or 128 GB DDR5-7200.

The GPU tile contains a smaller iGPU with 4 Xe3 cores and ray tracing support.

The third chiplet integrates the platform controller with 20 PCIe lanes (compared to 12 lanes of the other two Panther Lake chips), 4x Thunderbolt 4, Wi-Fi 7 (R2) and Bluetooth Core 6.0. The platform controller is also manufactured by TSMC.

The power consumption is specified from 15 W (minimum assured power) over 25 Watt (processor base power PL1) up to 80 W (maximum Turbo power).
